clause: Adjustment Preset Library: registry, categories, stock set, user entries, panel, persistence [STU-RAS-030,STU-COL-012]

scope.summary: Implement the canonical Adjustment Preset Library preset registry as one Studio primitive: a two-level category/entry tree, a stock set, user entries, and the full panel operation set. The reference implementation ships 172 stock entries across 26 categories (Levels (1), Default (7), WhiteBalance (1), HSL (1), Recolour (1), BlackAndWhite (1), BrightnessContrast (1), Posterise (1), Vibrance (1), Exposure (1), ShadowsHighlights (1), Threshold (1), Curves (1), ChannelMixer (1)). Entries and categories are durable SurrealDB records with EventLedger mutation events, owner-scoped, importable and exportable as a package.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: The Adjustment Preset Library registry ships 172 stock entries organised into the captured category set and every entry is listable, previewable, and applicable.
Categories support create, rename, reorder, duplicate, delete-with-contents-policy, import, and export as typed commands.
acceptance_criteria.source_evidence: affinity string table: Preset Manager / Presets panel command set

acceptance_criteria.criterion: A user entry is created from current settings, renamed, reordered across categories, and deleted, with name-collision handled by the documented policy rather than silent overwrite.
acceptance_criteria.source_evidence: affinity strings: 'The preset name you gave is already used by another preset' / '...by one of the stock presets'

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Stock entries are immutable: an edit to a stock entry forks a user copy and the stock entry is preserved.
Every entry and category row persists in SCHEMAFULL SurrealDB studio_* records with owner/AccessSpace linkage and replays after restart; a STUDIO_* EventLedger event is appended per mutation.
The Adjustment Preset Library panel is reachable by stable author_id, renders the category tree and entry grid, and each command is steerable and re-observable through Argus.
A second account in the same project cannot list, search, preview, or export another owner's user entries, and entry counts do not leak.
Import of a malformed or truncated preset package fails closed with a typed unsupported-feature receipt and a recovery instruction; no partial registry mutation is committed.

implementation_notes.container_format: Reference stock content is stored in a Serif KA container (adjustments.propcol, header 00ff4b410c0004006d6a644123496e66). Studio does not adopt that format; it ships its own SurrealDB-backed registry and a Handshake-native package format for import/export.
implementation_notes.naming: Do not ship vendor category or entry names verbatim as Studio product content. Use the captured structure to size the registry, the category model, and the panel; author Studio's own stock set.
implementation_notes.collision_policy: user entry name collision prompts; stock entry name collision forks a user copy

resource_privacy_obligation.identity_context: authenticated account + acting Principal + session + active AccessSpace; StudioDocument and every derived preset/thumbnail/index row carry owner + ResourceGrant linkage
resource_privacy_obligation.positive_case: owner in an authorised AccessSpace reads, edits, and exports the resource
resource_privacy_obligation.negative_case: a second account in the same project cannot read, list, search, preview, count, or export it; existence metadata does not leak
resource_privacy_obligation.derived_scope_rule: thumbnails, indexes, caches, and model context inherit the intersection of contributing source scopes and never widen
resource_privacy_obligation.revocation_rule: grant revocation or AccessSpace switch invalidates cached previews and in-flight reads promptly; running sessions stay pinned to immutable context
resource_privacy_obligation.note: User-authored presets are owner-scoped resources; stock content is installation-scoped and readable by every authenticated account.

validator_focus: Registry state must survive a real runtime restart from SurrealDB, not from an in-memory fixture.
Stock immutability must be proven by attempting a stock edit, not asserted in prose.
Cross-account isolation must cover metadata: counts, search hits, thumbnails, and export listings.
Reject the MT if the panel is not Argus-observable or if proof is fixture-only (Spec-Realism Gate sub-rule 2).
Confirm no vendor category or entry name shipped as Studio product content.
risk_if_missed: Adjustment Preset Library degrades to a flat unmanaged list: no categories, no user entries, no durable owner-scoped persistence, and no import/export path, which blocks professional asset reuse across documents and projects.

risks: Registry implemented as an in-memory Vec with a JSON sidecar instead of SurrealDB authority.
Thumbnails generated into a shared cache without owner scoping (metadata side channel).
Large stock registry loaded synchronously on the UI thread, stalling the shell.
Import path trusting package contents and partially mutating the registry before validation.
